name: Clear-winged Grasshopper
desc: Clear-winged Grasshopper (Camnula pellucida): eats plants or other primary food sources. Recorded 11 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Camnula is a genus of band-winged grasshopper in the family Acrididae. It contains one species, Camnula pellucida, the clearwinged grasshopper.
